Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Are you ready to design and build a resilient test automation framework from scratch using Python, Playwright, and Pytest?
 If you enjoy tackling complex enterprise workflows, eliminating UI flakiness, and integrating robust automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, this role is for you.
 Our philosophy is “First who, then what.” 
 📍 This role is hybrid, with 3 days on site in Bucharest, Romania.
 🚀 First who? 
Proven experience building and scaling UI test automation frameworks using Python , Playwright , and Pytest .
Strong grasp of test architecture, Page Object Model (POM), and BDD using Gherkin feature files.
Expertise in handling dynamic UI elements, resilient locator strategies, and auto-waiting to eliminate test flakiness.
Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines with Dockerized environments, parallel execution, and Allure reporting.
Strong analytical mindset to triage test runs, identify root causes, and separate application bugs from test defects.
Proactive collaborator who works closely with developers and DevOps engineers to clear blockers early.
 🚀 Then what? 
You’ll architect and own the end-to-end test automation framework for an enterprise-wide platform.
You’ll automate complex business flows across multi-evaluator assessments, campaigns, and hierarchy-based scopes.
You’ll establish a dependable, maintenance-friendly regression suite that engineering teams rely on for releases.
 📌 Your mission 
Design and build the automation framework using Pytest fixtures, Playwright configuration, Gherkin, and a resilient POM
Automate end-to-end functional areas: record management, bid submissions, watchlists, multi-evaluator workflows, and reporting
Prevent UI flakiness using robust Playwright locator strategies and auto-waiting mechanisms
Partner with DevOps to configure CI/CD pipelines, Dockerized execution, parallel test runs, and Allure test reports
Execute full suites in staging, triage failures, and document clear technical defects
Maintain regression tests across application releases to ensure high suite stability and trust
Write technical documentation covering local test execution, pipeline integration, and troubleshooting
Collaborate directly with software developers to map workflows, data structures, and test requirements
 ⚙️ Your toolbox Technical Skills 
Python & Pytest (fixtures, execution)
Playwright & Page Object Model (POM)
BDD & Gherkin feature files
Docker & CI/CD pipeline integration
Parallel test execution & Allure reporting
Dynamic UI handling & resilient locator strategies
Git & version control
 General Skills
Strong root-cause analysis and defect triage mindset
Proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration (Developers, DevOps)
Autonomous ownership of framework architecture and documentation
Ability to understand complex, hierarchy-driven business workflows
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the First who and see yourself thriving in the Then what? 
 👉 Apply now and let’s talk.
